audit_metadata.audit_type: Full-Stack Forensic QA & Connection Integrity Audit

findings.title: Token Decryption Failure on Legacy or Mismatched Ciphertext
findings.root_cause: Single-key Fernet decrypt without rotation list causes uncaught InvalidToken exceptions on secret rotation or truncated ciphertext in database.
findings.impact: Triggers HTTP 500 error when resolving Google connection status for existing accounts.
findings.remediation: Implement multi-key candidate fallback list in decrypt_token and gracefully prompt for re-authentication.

findings.title: Google Business Profile API Quota=0 Access Restriction
findings.root_cause: External Google Cloud Project OAuth client requires Google Partner approval for GBP Management API quota.
findings.impact: Unapproved developer accounts cannot list GBP locations directly from Google API.
findings.remediation: Catch quota=0 errors specifically, fall back to Google Places Public Maps data and Local SEO crawler, and display scope explanation banner.

findings.title: Acceptance Test Import Error Halting Pytest Discovery
findings.root_cause: FindingStatus enum is located in app.models.audit, not app.models.local_seo.
findings.impact: Halts whole-repository automated test discovery when executing pytest.
findings.remediation: Change import to from app.models.audit import FindingStatus.

findings.title: AI Content Opportunities 500 Error on Float or Null Search Volumes
findings.root_cause: Strict int type annotation in Pydantic schema causes validation failure when upstream GSC metrics are float or null.
findings.impact: 500 Internal Server Error when querying Content Gaps view.
findings.remediation: Update schema to Optional[int] = 0 with numeric pre-validation.

findings.title: Missing Defensive Array Guard in ConnectionsView
findings.root_cause: Direct .filter() call on gbpLocations without Array.isArray guard.
findings.impact: Potential React render crash if backend returns wrapped dictionary or null.
findings.remediation: Add Array.isArray(gbpLocations) check before calling filter.

findings.title: Directory Distribution Aggregator Direct Sync Boundary
findings.root_cause: Platform is structured for crawler verification and link discovery rather than paid direct publishing API sync.
findings.impact: User expectation of direct one-click publishing without aggregator API connection.
findings.remediation: Annotate verification vs direct publishing in UI.

findings.title: Nested XML Sitemap Namespace Extraction Failure
findings.root_cause: Regex/XML parser fails to match loc tags with custom XML namespaces.
findings.impact: Incomplete URL discovery on sitemaps with custom XML extensions.
findings.remediation: Strip XML namespaces before loc node extraction.

findings.title: OpenSERP Local Pack Selector Fragility
findings.root_cause: Single CSS selector path for Google local 3-pack cards.
findings.impact: Rank 0 results if Google modifies localized search markup.
findings.remediation: Implement multi-selector fallback chain and auto-failover to SerpApi/ValueSERP.

findings.title: NAP Address Abbreviation Normalization Discrepancy
findings.root_cause: String comparison without standard USPS abbreviation dictionary.
findings.impact: Minor formatting variations flagged as NAP inconsistencies.
findings.remediation: Apply standardized USPS abbreviation normalization before diffing.

findings.title: Geo-Grid Rescan Metric Delta on Differing Matrix Dimensions
findings.root_cause: Delta algorithm assumes identical point count between compared scans.
findings.impact: Returns 0.0 delta when comparing different matrix sizes.
findings.remediation: Compute macro Average Grid Rank (AGR) delta across scans of varying sizes.

findings.title: Google Maps JavaScript API Key Requirement
findings.root_cause: Standard third-party requirement for Google Maps JS API.
findings.impact: Shows development notice if VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY is not set.

findings.title: SQLite Foreign Key Enforcement Pragma
findings.root_cause: SQLite requires explicit foreign keys pragma on connection.
